fields.why: NREVSS, whose positive-test counts feed the normalized case frequencies and weights, is a CDC-run passive network of about 540 laboratories, so it fits either 'CDC surveillance system' (B, which cites NREVSS there) or 'sentinel/network' (A). The brief's common cases list neither NREVSS nor laboratory networks like it.

brief_issues: Add NREVSS (and similar CDC laboratory reporting networks) to the data_source_type common cases, e.g. 'NREVSS: CDC surveillance system (sentinel/network also acceptable)'.
